jobs.title: Basic Life Research Scientist
jobs.description:
Job Description

Healthcare and medicine today stand at the Center of a major paradigm shift. Stanford Medicine is firing on all engines to push the frontiers heralding this Paradigm Shift. Here at Stanford Medicine, almost all disciplines are joining forces to solve human health miseries that are keeping us fearful of being a prey to them. The Stanford Amrita–Jagadeesh Digital Health Collaboratory was created to have an even bigger Impact by working together to solve some of the formidable challenges in healthcare.

The Academic Staff-Research (AS-R) position is a key role in sustaining and expanding the Collaboratory to be a synergistic Hi-5 Ecosystem of Interdisciplinary Research, International & Industry partnerships for Research, and Translational Research. Snyder Lab’s vision and scientific leadership have helped bring together an extraordinary community of researchers and clinicians. In this AS-R role, the recruited person would work with postdocs, graduate students and other researchers to identify grant proposal opportunities, mentor the writing and submission of research proposals, garner funding support from Industry, and push for translational clinical trials for as many research projects as possible to have impact that reaches patients as their outcome. The AS-R position also has the responsibility for building bridges across institutions and disciplines, so that there is a healthy cross-pollination of ideas.

The Position of AS-R also carries with it the responsibility for developing an Integrated Strategic Plan for the Digital Health Collaboratory, with a focus on five grand challenge areas namely: (1) Global and Population Health, (2) Multidisciplinary and Translational Medicine, (3) Data Driven Precision Medicine, (4) Artificial Intelligence (AI) & Machine Learning (ML) in Medicine, and (5) Innovation in Limited Resource Settings.

Ideal person for this position is a Physician-Scientist who is passionate about improving health care. The Core Duties will include:

Initiate multi-center research studies in 3P Medicine
Design and Develop 3D & 3I Personal Health Dashboards
Deploy and Evaluate AI-LLM based decision support systems & AI agents
Track the following Outcomes : (a) Delivering the three A’s (Affordability, Accessibility, Availability) in global health; (b) Accelerated translation of bio-medical inventions; (c) Enhancing data-driven medicine through access to a widening spectrum of patient data; (d) Robust clinical validation of emerging AI/ML techniques; (e) Sustaining innovation and quality in healthcare delivery without compromising compassionate pricing or timeliness even in the face of rising costs and increasing patient volume
Forge global scientific partnerships targeted towards addressing the grand challenges in Medicine
Organize annual symposium, Roundtable meetings for each Grand Challenge area

Qualifications / Minimum Requirements

MD or equivalent, prior postdoc experience of at least 1 year and also completion of internal medicine residency, International research experience

MD or equivalent Medical Degree
Postdoctoral Research Experience of at least 1 Year
Residency in Internal Medicine or equivalent would be a big plus to be able to carry out clinical trials
Publications in Reputed Journals with first Co-Authorship
Proven experience in a large scale, high profile or mission critical project
Proven experience working with AI, particularly LLMs and Decision Support Systems
Expert programming skills in Python
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with International research experience

jobs.title: Principal, Data Scientist - Applied Machine Learning
jobs.description:
Position Summary...As a Principal Data Scientist, you will lead the design and delivery of machine learning solutions that power personalization and ad targeting across VIZIO. You'll own complex, ambiguous problems end to end—translating product and customer needs into scalable ML models and iterating them through rigorous evaluation and experimentation. You will work closely with Product and Engineering partners to influence direction, navigate technical tradeoffs, and advance long term ML strategy. You will set the technical standard for modeling and experimentation, contribute hands on advanced deep learning models at scale, and mentor other data scientists with a focus on quality and impact.

About The Team

We are a machine learning team focused on personalization across VIZIO’s platform. Leveraging expertise in deep learning and statistical data analysis, the group focuses on creating scalable and powerful deep learning models using frameworks like PyTorch and MLflow. Collaborating closely with cross-functional partners, the team continuously enhances model performance and deployment to deliver impactful user experiences. This environment encourages innovation, rigorous testing, and application of best practices to solve complex challenges in recommender systems and ad targeting, contributing to the platform’s growth and customer engagement.

What you'll do...

Tackle ambiguous, high-impact problems by translating product and business questions into scalable machine learning solutions.
Build, evaluate, and iterate on advanced deep learning models for personalization, recommendation, and targeting.
Design and apply rigorous offline metrics and online experimentation frameworks to measure model and system performance.
Partner closely with Product and Engineering to align on scope, navigate technical tradeoffs, and drive execution across multiple teams.
Define and champion best practices for modeling, experimentation, and ML development, with a focus on robustness, scalability, and maintainability.
Provide technical leadership through design reviews, collaboration, and hands-on problem solving while helping raise the quality and impact of machine learning solutions.

What you'll bring - Extensive experience designing, training, and deploying machine learning models for real-world systems, particularly in personalization, recommendation, ranking, or targeting. - Deep technical foundations in machine learning and statistics, including representation learning, deep learning architectures, optimization, experimentation, and model evaluation. - Production Python experience, expertise with distributed data tools such as PySpark, and proficiency with modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX. - Proven ability to lead ambiguous, technically complex initiatives spanning multiple stakeholders from problem formulation through deployment and evolution. - Experience influencing technical direction, establishing best practices, and driving high-quality machine learning solutions through technical leadership.

At Walmart, we offer competitive pay as well as performance-based bonus awards and other great benefits for a happier mind, body, and wallet. Health benefits include medical, vision and dental coverage. Financial benefits include 401(k), stock purchase and company-paid life insurance. Paid time off benefits include PTO (including sick leave), parental leave, family care leave, bereavement, jury duty, and voting. Other benefits include short-term and long-term disability, company discounts, Military Leave Pay, adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, and more. You will also receive PTO and/or PPTO that can be used for vacation, sick leave, holidays, or other purposes. The amount you receive depends on your job classification and length of employment. It will meet or exceed the requirements of paid sick leave laws, where applicable. For information about PTO, see https://one.walmart.com/notices. Live Better U is a Walmart-paid education benefit program for full-time and part-time associates in Walmart and Sam's Club facilities. Programs range from high school completion to bachelor's degrees, including English Language Learning and short-form certificates. Tuition, books, and fees are completely paid for by Walmart.

Eligibility requirements apply to some benefits and may depend on your job classification and length of employment. Benefits are subject to change and may be subject to a specific plan or program terms.

For Information About Benefits And Eligibility, See One.Walmart.

Outlined below are the required minimum qualifications for this position. If none are listed, there are no minimum qualifications.

Option 1- Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Economics, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field and 3 years' experience in an analytics related field. Option 2- Master’s degree in Statistics, Economics, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field and 1 years' experience in an analytics related field. Option 3 - 5 years' experience in an analytics or related field.

Preferred Qualifications...

Outlined below are the optional preferred qualifications for this position. If none are listed, there are no preferred qualifications.

Data science, machine learning, optimization models, PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Information Technology, Operations Research, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Econometrics, Publications or active peer reviewer in related journals or conference, Successful completion of one or more assessments in Python, Spark, Scala, or R, Using open source frameworks (for example, scikit learn, tensorflow, torch), We value candidates with a background in creating inclusive digital experiences, demonstrating knowledge in implementing Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 AA standards, assistive technologies, and integrating digital accessibility seamlessly.
